## Summary

I've implemented the chore to enrich mock products with comprehensive fashion attributes:

### Work Completed:
- **Created `apps/web/lib/mock-data02.ts`** with:
  - `ColorTone` type (`'warm' | 'cool' | 'neutral'`)
  - `EnhancedMockProduct` interface extending the base `Product` type with 14 fashion attributes
  - `enhancedMockProducts` array containing all 14 products with enriched data

- **Enriched all 14 products** (CG001-CG008, SF001-SF004, LO001, SH001-SH002) with:
  - `styleTags` - Style classifications (classic, minimalist, corporate-chic, etc.)
  - `seasonType` - Seasonal suitability (all-season, hot-season, cool-season)
  - `formalityLevel` - 1-10 formality scale
  - `fitType` - Fit classification (regular, tailored, slim, etc.)
  - `patternType` - Pattern type (solid, floral, print, etc.)
  - `materialType` - Material composition (cotton, polyester, leather, etc.)
  - `colorTone` - Color temperature (warm, cool, neutral)
  - `aesthetic` - Pinterest 2026 aesthetic category
  - `colorPalette` - Trending color palette
  - `outfitRole` - Item role in outfit (top, bottom, dress, footwear, etc.)
  - `brandTier` - Brand positioning (budget, mid-range)
  - `pairingCategories` - Compatible product categories for outfit matching
  - `layeringStyle` - Layering style (fitted, structured, relaxed)
  - `silhouetteType` - Silhouette classification

- **Validated TypeScript compilation** - No type errors
